data.name: Bulhut
data.gender_notes: Bulhut is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bulhut is derived from the Arabic word ‘bulhulah’, which means ‘a fragrant flower’. This name is mentioned in a Hadith narrated by Anas ibn Malik, who reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: ‘The name of the best of you is the one who has the best name.’ This name is considered to have a spiritual and beautiful meaning, and is a reminder of the importance of good character and a pleasant disposition.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the beauty and fragrance of good character.
data.etymology: Bulhut belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A fragrant flower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bulhut total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_english.long_meaning: The name Bulhut is derived from the Arabic root 'bḥ-w-t', which means to dive or plunge into something. It signifies one who delves deeply into knowledge and wisdom. The name embodies the qualities of intellectual curiosity and spiritual depth.
